I am here in Dar es Salaam region with my big plot of 13.40 hectares, and even though it is a large piece of land for a woman like me to manage alone, I have been farming it for many years with my family. The soils here near the coast are sandy and tired, so I always put manure from my few goats and chickens on the parts I can reach, but I cannot cover the whole plot. I will buy some urea and DAP from the agro-dealer in town because last season the maize and cassava intercrop did better where I put fertilizer, but cash is tight so I will not apply heavy rates everywhere. I must hire labor because 13 hectares is too much for just me and my family — weeding alone needs many hands during the rains.
